A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the type bar and the game-text box) with its corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Jedi-L-forluck-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[For Luck (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words as the previous version. The slip no longer prints the title in its black strip; the “E” stays at the lower right.

The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip, both as cut from their sheets at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
